meanings.en: the state of being united or working well together as a whole
meanings.exampleEn: Team cohesion was the main reason for their success.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım bütünlüğü başarılarının ana sebebiydi.

meanings.en: to criticize someone or something unfairly; to belittle
meanings.exampleEn: He constantly tried to denigrate his colleagues' achievements.
meanings.exampleTr: Meslektaşlarının başarılarını sürekli küçümsemeye çalışıyordu.

meanings.en: to laugh at or mock someone in a scornful way
meanings.exampleEn: Critics derided the film as shallow and predictable.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler filmi sığ ve öngörülebilir diye alaya aldı.

meanings.en: to praise someone or something highly
meanings.exampleEn: The mayor was lauded for his response to the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Belediye başkanı krize verdiği tepki nedeniyle övüldü.

meanings.en: consisting of parts or people that are all the same kind
meanings.exampleEn: The neighborhood was once ethnically homogeneous.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahalle bir zamanlar etnik olarak türdeşti.

meanings.en: a person or device that controls or directs something
meanings.exampleEn: The game console came with two wireless controllers.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyun konsolu iki kablosuz kumandayla geldi.

meanings.en: a person in charge of a company's financial accounts
meanings.exampleEn: The financial controller reviewed the annual budget.
meanings.exampleTr: Mali kontrolör yıllık bütçeyi inceledi.

meanings.en: far more than is usual or reasonable; excessive
meanings.exampleEn: She spent an inordinate amount of time on trivial details.
meanings.exampleTr: Önemsiz ayrıntılara aşırı miktarda zaman harcadı.

meanings.en: corresponding in size or amount to something else
meanings.exampleEn: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceza, suçla orantılı olmalıdır.

meanings.en: having become smaller or wrinkled by shrinking
meanings.exampleEn: The old man's shrunken face showed his age.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı adamın büzülmüş yüzü yaşını gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: able to be seen, recognized, or understood
meanings.exampleEn: There was no discernible difference between the two samples.
meanings.exampleTr: İki örnek arasında fark edilebilir bir fark yoktu.

meanings.en: easy to identify or know from previous experience
meanings.exampleEn: Her voice was instantly recognizable on the phone.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonda sesi anında tanınabilirdi.

meanings.en: gave a false or misleading account of something
meanings.exampleEn: The report misrepresented the facts to support its conclusion.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, vardığı sonucu desteklemek için gerçekleri çarpıttı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you are not paying attention because you are thinking of something else
meanings.exampleEn: She absent-mindedly stirred her coffee while reading.
meanings.exampleTr: Okurken dalgın dalgın kahvesini karıştırdı.

meanings.en: a long narrow hole dug in the ground
meanings.exampleEn: Soldiers took cover in the muddy trench.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler çamurlu siperde saklandı.

meanings.en: tending to come together or meet at a point
meanings.exampleEn: The two lines of research turned out to be convergent.
meanings.exampleTr: İki araştırma hattının yakınsak olduğu ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: causing people to divide into two sharply opposing groups
meanings.exampleEn: The candidate was a deeply polarizing figure.
meanings.exampleTr: Aday, derinden kutuplaştırıcı bir figürdü.

meanings.en: without enthusiasm or real effort
meanings.exampleEn: He half-heartedly agreed to help with the move.
meanings.exampleTr: Taşınmaya yardım etmeyi isteksizce kabul etti.

meanings.en: the state of being the most powerful or highest in rank
meanings.exampleEn: The empire fought to maintain its naval supremacy.
meanings.exampleTr: İmparatorluk deniz üstünlüğünü korumak için savaştı.

meanings.en: a person who gives money, help, or ideas to something
meanings.exampleEn: She was a regular contributor to the science journal.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim dergisine düzenli katkıda bulunan biriydi.

meanings.tr: gizli, saklı, örtük, henüz açığa çıkmamış
meanings.en: existing but not yet active, developed, or visible
meanings.exampleEn: The training helped unlock his latent talent.
meanings.exampleTr: Eğitim, onun gizli yeteneğini ortaya çıkarmaya yardımcı oldu.

meanings.tr: düşük kaliteli, ucuz segment, alt segment
meanings.en: cheap and of relatively low quality
meanings.exampleEn: They started by selling low-end smartphones.
meanings.exampleTr: İşe düşük segment akıllı telefonlar satarak başladılar.

meanings.en: the positive or advantageous aspect of a situation
meanings.exampleEn: The upside of the delay was extra time to prepare.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikmenin olumlu yönü, hazırlanmak için ekstra zamandı.

meanings.en: the state of feeling ready or inclined to sleep
meanings.exampleEn: The medication can cause drowsiness and sleepiness.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç uyuşukluğa ve uyku haline neden olabilir.

meanings.en: the state of being drunk
meanings.exampleEn: His inebriation was obvious from his slurred speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Sarhoşluğu, peltek konuşmasından belliydi.

meanings.en: a channel or pipe for carrying liquids or wires; a means of transmitting something
meanings.exampleEn: The organization served as a conduit for foreign aid.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuruluş, dış yardım için bir aracı görevi gördü.

meanings.en: deceitful behavior in which someone acts dishonestly toward others
meanings.exampleEn: The partnership collapsed after his double-dealing was exposed.
meanings.exampleTr: Ortaklık, onun ikiyüzlülüğü ortaya çıkınca çöktü.

meanings.en: continuing or existing for a long time
meanings.exampleEn: The treaty brought a long-lasting peace to the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Antlaşma bölgeye uzun süreli bir barış getirdi.

meanings.en: able to withstand a lot of use without becoming damaged
meanings.exampleEn: These boots are made of hard-wearing leather.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu botlar dayanıklı deriden yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: to or for each one; each
meanings.exampleEn: The tickets cost twenty dollars apiece.
meanings.exampleTr: Biletler tanesi yirmi dolardı.

meanings.tr: peri, küçük şirin cin, orman perisi
meanings.en: a small imaginary being with magical powers, often mischievous
meanings.exampleEn: The story is about a mischievous pixie living in the woods.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikaye, ormanda yaşayan yaramaz bir periyi anlatıyor.

meanings.en: decorative details added to something to make it more attractive
meanings.exampleEn: The cathedral's façade was covered in elaborate ornamentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Katedralin cephesi özenli süslemelerle kaplıydı.

meanings.en: feeling intimidated or discouraged by something difficult
meanings.exampleEn: She was not daunted by the size of the task ahead.
meanings.exampleTr: Önündeki işin büyüklüğünden yılmadı.

meanings.en: based on new ideas or methods that are still being tested
meanings.exampleEn: The hospital offered an experimental treatment for the disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastane, hastalık için deneysel bir tedavi sundu.

meanings.en: the quality of being empty inside, or of lacking real meaning or sincerity
meanings.exampleEn: He felt the hollowness of their empty promises.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş vaatlerinin içi boşluğunu hissetti.

meanings.en: to attract and hold someone's attention completely
meanings.exampleEn: The dancer's performance captivated the entire audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçının performansı tüm izleyicileri büyüledi.

meanings.en: to enchant someone as if by magic; to fascinate completely
meanings.exampleEn: Her beauty seemed to bewitch everyone in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Güzelliği odadaki herkesi büyülemiş gibiydi.

meanings.en: to convert coded or encrypted data into readable form
meanings.exampleEn: Analysts managed to decrypt the intercepted messages.
meanings.exampleTr: Analistler ele geçirilen mesajların şifresini çözmeyi başardı.

meanings.en: a word, especially an adverb, that makes the meaning of another word stronger
meanings.exampleEn: The word 'very' is a common intensifier in English.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Very' kelimesi İngilizcede yaygın bir pekiştireçtir.

meanings.en: to remove a ruler or champion from power or their leading position
meanings.exampleEn: The challenger dethroned the reigning champion in three rounds.
meanings.exampleTr: Meydan okuyan kişi, hüküm süren şampiyonu üç raundda tahtından etti.

meanings.en: the whole of something; the complete amount
meanings.exampleEn: We must consider the totality of the evidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Kanıtların tamamını göz önünde bulundurmalıyız.

meanings.en: the act of asking for something humbly and earnestly, often in prayer
meanings.exampleEn: She knelt in supplication before the altar.
meanings.exampleTr: Sunağın önünde yakarışla diz çöktü.

meanings.en: the activity or sport of riding a horse
meanings.exampleEn: She has taken horse-riding lessons since childhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukluğundan beri binicilik dersleri alıyor.

meanings.en: the act of providing someone or something with equipment or clothes
meanings.exampleEn: The company specializes in outfitting expeditions to remote areas.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, uzak bölgelere yapılan keşif gezilerini donatma konusunda uzmanlaşmıştır.

meanings.en: a rapid increase in the number or amount of something
meanings.exampleEn: The proliferation of smartphones changed daily life.
meanings.exampleTr: Akıllı telefonların hızla yayılması günlük hayatı değiştirdi.

meanings.en: light rain; fine drizzle
meanings.exampleEn: A cold mizzle drifted across the moor all afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonra boyunca kırın üzerinde soğuk bir çiseleme sürükleniyordu.
